title: Message in the Static

beats.narrativeText: Atlas successfully restores part of the outpost's communications array.
Among the recovered audio files is a heavily corrupted transmission from Dr. Elara Quinn, with large portions missing.
The learner listens for repeated patterns, missing words and contextual clues within the damaged message.
Piecing the clues together, the learner begins decoding what the message actually says.
The learner must complete the missing sections and compare possible interpretations of the message.
The learner identifies which facts in the reconstructed message are confirmed.
The learner reflects on what the recovered message reveals about the expedition's actions.
The message suggests the expedition deliberately shut down parts of the station — but gives no explanation why.

activities.title: Decode Damaged Messages
activities.storyContext: A heavily corrupted transmission from Dr. Elara Quinn has been recovered from the restored communications array.
activities.instructions: Read through the damaged transmission and note any words or phrases you can make out.
activities.output: Notes on what can be understood from the damaged transmission.

activities.title: Complete Missing Sections
activities.storyContext: Large portions of the message are missing and must be reconstructed from context.
activities.instructions: Use repeated patterns and context clues to suggest what the missing sections might say.
activities.output: A reconstructed version of the message.

activities.title: Compare Possible Interpretations
activities.storyContext: More than one interpretation of the reconstructed message may seem plausible.
activities.instructions: Compare a few possible interpretations of the message and decide which is best supported by the evidence.
activities.output: Notes comparing possible interpretations of the message.

activities.title: Identify Confirmed Facts
activities.storyContext: Not everything in the reconstructed message can be fully trusted.
activities.instructions: List the facts from the message that are confirmed by clear evidence.
activities.output: A list of confirmed facts from the message.

activities.title: Create a Coded Message
activities.storyContext: Now that the learner understands how coded messages work, they can create one of their own.
activities.instructions: Create a coded message of your own for another Explorer to solve.

activities.title: Recovering Damaged Historical Records
activities.storyContext: Recovering this message is similar to real scientific and historical work.
activities.instructions: Find out how scientists recover damaged historical documents or radio transmissions.
activities.output: None required — this is an open investigation.

prompts: What do you think the expedition was hiding when they shut down parts of the station?

discussionPoints: What clues helped you fill in the missing parts of the message?
Why might the expedition have deliberately gone quiet?
parentGuide.assessment: Look for reasonable, evidence-based guesses for the missing sections, and a clear list of confirmed facts.

completionCriteria: Damaged message decoded, missing sections completed, and confirmed facts identified.
